verdict.rationale: Fern ships an official, documented CLI that initializes projects, validates API definitions, previews changes locally with hot reload, and publishes docs and SDKs. Its MCP server lets coding agents look up CLI commands from the terminal, which supports agent-driven use. The JSON-first, agent-pipeable CLI material describes CLIs Fern generates for customers' APIs, not Fern's own tool, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence that Fern's own CLI has agent-friendly output (JSON or non-interactive modes), install/distribution details for Fern's own CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
